topology: same-host native Claude with native local tools, settings hooks via --settings, scripted loopback API, disposable homes
observations: PreToolUse exit 2 refuses as 'PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [cmd]: stderr'; a JSON deny or legacy block refuses as 'PreToolUse:Bash hook error: reason'; exit 1 and plain stdout are non-blocking
PreToolUse ask prompts the SDK host even in bypassPermissions; allow with updatedInput runs the amended input
PreToolUse continue:false still runs the tool, then ends the turn; also when the tool then fails
matchers are full-match, case-sensitive regular expressions; '*' and empty match everything
PostToolUse exit 2 reports 'PostToolUse:X hook blocking error from command: "cmd": [cmd]: stderr'; block reports '...: "cmd": reason'; additionalContext reports 'X:Y hook additional context: ...'
a non-zero Bash exit is a tool error 'Exit code N' followed by the merged output; PostToolUse does not run and PostToolUseFailure does
PostToolUseFailure exit 2 reports 'PostToolUseFailure:Bash hook blocking error from command: ...'; its continue:false does not end the turn
PreToolUse additionalContext still reaches the model after the tool fails
a successful Bash with no output reads '(Bash completed with no output)'; with output, only the merged output
an unparsable project .claude/settings.json is skipped and the session runs
a subagent's PreToolUse input carries agent_id, agent_type and the main session's transcript_path; SubagentStop carries agent_transcript_path

PermissionRequest hooks run concurrently with the SDK host prompt: with an instant host the host decides; with a slow host a hook allow (with updatedInput) or deny (message verbatim) decides, deny with interrupt fails the turn, exit 2 or no decision leaves it to the host
PermissionRequest input has permission_suggestions and no tool_use_id
several PermissionRequest hooks: the first decision wins (fast allow beat a 2 s deny); decisions arriving together resolve to deny
conclusion: These native-local behaviors are the contract the 3.7.0 remote hook adapter reproduces for facade-routed target tools.
